answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and let that stake be slashed when peers prove a duplicate identity. A fake farm on a grassy knoll of cheap accounts then faces a real bill: every violet-flagged duplicate loses its bond, while a hollow shell with no stake earns nothing. Scaling the attack means funding thousands of bonds, so Sybil creation stops being free and becomes a priced, auditable cost.
